text: To toggle compact mode, I currently go into the leader key and then type V and then type M. Instead rename this to overview mode and make the keyboard shortcut the letter O directly at the leader key root. So when it is enabled, it should say overview disabled. When it's disabled, it should say overview enabled, essentially turning it into a toggle.

I want to hijack the mod plus F. Make it bring up the native search we have built, the same 1 that comes up when we click on the magnifying glass icon. But if that is already focused or active and then we hit mod plus f it should then go to the browser find

Doc-reference peek rendering — expand a doc chip in place to show the referenced section read-only (SPEC key decision 19 names this as future work). Wants heading-anchor support for per-section peeks.
Doc-reference heading anchors — recognize plans/foo.md#slug in the doc token and scroll/peek to that heading. SPEC key decision 19.
Doctor-style existence check for doc references — validation warns when a .md path in node text points at a missing file, catching renames. SPEC key decision 19.

Line numbers in file references — support @src/foo.ts:42 in the token and a {line} placeholder in editor templates. Fiddly because each preset delimits lines differently (:{line} vs &line={line}) and the no-line case must not leave a dangling delimiter. SPEC key decision 19.
